articles.title: Cómo tomar fotos y videos sin que ocupen demasiado espacio en la memoria del celular
articles.text:
Los teléfonos actuales prometen fotos de calidad profesional, pero ese salto en definición tiene un costo silencioso: el almacenamiento interno se llena mucho más rápido de lo que parece.
Ajustar unas pocas opciones de la cámara, antes de disparar, permite reducir el peso de cada archivo sin que la diferencia visual resulte perceptible en el uso cotidiano.
PUBLICIDAD
Cómo reducir los megapíxeles sin arruinar la foto
Los megapíxeles determinan el tamaño final de una fotografía. Un sensor de 64 megapíxeles no obliga a disparar siempre a esa resolución máxima: de hecho, muchos teléfonos ya configuran por defecto valores de 16 o 12 megapíxeles.
Mantener esa resolución intermedia conserva una calidad suficiente para el uso diario y reduce de forma notable el peso de cada imagen. El modo de máxima resolución conviene reservarlo para ocasiones puntuales en las que se necesite el mayor detalle posible, no para el uso cotidiano.
El formato RAW responde a la misma lógica: ofrece más información por imagen, pero también genera archivos mucho más pesados. Para el día a día, el formato JPEG del modo “Foto” estándar resulta suficiente en la mayoría de las situaciones.
PUBLICIDAD
Bajar de la máxima resolución a 12 o 16 megapíxeles en fotos, y de 4K a 1.080p en vídeos, reduce sustancialmente el peso de los archivos sin una pérdida de calidad perceptible en el uso diario del teléfono.
- Grabar en Full HD en lugar de 4K u 8K
Con las cámaras actuales es posible grabar en 4K o incluso 8K, resoluciones pensadas para producciones que después se editan o montan con cierto nivel profesional.
Para el vídeo cotidiano, el FullHD (1.080p) mantiene una calidad adecuada mientras reduce el tamaño del archivo de forma considerable, en ocasiones por varios gigabytes de diferencia frente al 4K.
En los ajustes de grabación también suele aparecer la opción de 720p HD, un escalón por debajo del FullHD. No es necesario llegar a ese mínimo, pero conviene tenerlo presente si el espacio disponible es realmente escaso.
PUBLICIDAD
La resolución más alta puede reservarse para grabaciones puntuales: eventos importantes o vídeos que luego se piensan editar con mayor detalle, dejando el resto de las grabaciones diarias en formatos más livianos.
- Activar los ajustes de ahorro de la propia cámara
Buena parte de los teléfonos incluyen, dentro de la configuración de la cámara, un apartado orientado específicamente a optimizar el almacenamiento.
Estos ajustes suelen reducir de forma automática la resolución de fotos y vídeos, además de aplicar otros pequeños cambios pensados para ahorrar espacio sin sacrificar demasiada calidad visual.
La ubicación exacta de esta opción varía según el fabricante y el modelo de teléfono, ya que cada marca organiza sus menús de manera distinta. En general, conviene revisar el menú de configuración dentro de la propia aplicación de cámara para localizarlo.
PUBLICIDAD
Trucos para ahorrar almacenamiento con fotos y videos
- Buscar y borrar fotos y vídeos duplicados
Es habitual terminar con varias fotografías casi idénticas de la misma escena, o con archivos que se duplicaron al compartirlos por otras aplicaciones. Estos archivos repetidos ocupan espacio de forma innecesaria, en particular los vídeos.
En los iPhone, la propia aplicación Fotos incluye una función para localizar duplicados y fusionarlos, quedándose con la versión de mejor calidad.
En Android, esta tarea requiere recurrir a aplicaciones de terceros especializadas en detectar imágenes repetidas. Dado que este tipo de herramientas necesita acceso completo a la galería del teléfono, conviene revisar previamente sus condiciones de privacidad.
- Recurrir a la nube o a un pendrive
Cuando el almacenamiento ya está comprometido y no se quiere renunciar a la calidad de los archivos existentes, la alternativa pasa por sacarlos del teléfono.
PUBLICIDAD
Los servicios de almacenamiento en la nube, como iCloud Fotos en iPhone y Google Fotos en Android, permiten guardar el contenido y consultarlo desde cualquier dispositivo, liberando espacio interno del teléfono.
Otra opción es un pendrive USB. Basta con que cuente con conector USB-C, el mismo que usan la mayoría de los teléfonos actuales para cargarse, o con un adaptador si el dispositivo utiliza otro tipo de puerto. Los modelos de iPhone anteriores al iPhone 15 requieren, en cambio, un conector Lightning.
Conectado al teléfono, un pendrive permite mover archivos con cualquier gestor de archivos del sistema, una solución especialmente útil para los vídeos, que suelen ser los que más espacio ocupan dentro de la memoria interna.

articles.title: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol delivers Astra-like performance at a dramatically lower price - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
OpenAI’s GPT-6.1 Sol delivers Astra-like performance at a dramatically lower price
Just a day after OpenAI Group PBC said it’s unwilling to release its latest model GPT-6.1 Astra on concerns over its safety, it has released a newer, almost as powerful model called GPT-6.1 Sol, which promises to deliver Astra-like performance at a much lower cost.
The new model, announced at OpenAI’s DevDay event today, is confusing because of the way it seems to make a mockery of OpenAI’s model naming convention, which became much more confusing during the summer when it first debuted GPT-5.6. Back then, it announced three versions of that model – Sol, Terra and Luna. Sol was the most powerful version, Terra sat in the middle, and Luna was the lower-cost, lightweight option for when costs and speed matter more than accuracy.
Though that originally made sense, things became more confusing when the company moved on to GPT-6 and gave it the “Astra” moniker. It said Astra is the most powerful version of the model, and shortly afterwards released two others in Luna and Sol. Terra had somehow been ditched, and Sol had been relegated to the mid-tier.
Now comes GPT-6.1 Sol, and the company says it’s more or less comparable with GPT-6.0 Astra in terms of its performance, especially in coding and intelligence-based tasks, the difference being that it’s much cheaper.
OpenAI presented a series of benchmark results to hammer home that point. For instance on DeepSWE 1.1, a benchmark to evaluate models’ software engineering performance, GPT-6.1 Sol achieved the same score as GPT-6 Astra at a cost of roughly one-fifth as many tokens per task. On the AutomationBench benchmark, which measures how well agents perform in multistep business workflows, GPT-6.1 Sol fell just short of GPT-6 Astra’s performance, but outperformed Anthropic PBC’s Claude Opus 5.5 while costing around one-third in terms of token consumption.
OpenAI also tested GPT-6.1 Sol on computer use tasks, where it beat out GPT-6 Sol by more than 7%, falling just short of GPT-6.1 Astra. The company said it also recorded fewer factual errors compared to GPT-6 Sol. The cost savings of using GPT-6.1 Sol instead of GPT-6.0 Astra are significant, OpenAI said. The new model is said to cost just 10 cent per million tokens, which is about half the price of GPT-6.0 Astra. It’s for this reason that OpenAI recommends the model for repeated and long-running workloads in coding and on application and document work.
Despite this, Astra remains OpenAI’s most powerful model, but the problem is that the company believes it’s so powerful, in fact, that it’s not safe to release it publicly at the moment. That’s why OpenAI announced yesterday it was delaying its release indefinitely, pointing to warnings from its own researchers and also third parties that have had the opportunity to study it that it had a tendency to do things without permission. It had planned to launch GPT-6.1 Astra today at its DevDay event, but the delay means that the new Sol gets all of the headlines instead.
The company said it’s making GPT-6.1 Sol available to all ChatGPT Work and Codex Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Edu subscribers from today. It’s not yet available for the standard ChatGPT application, but should become an option there soon.
OpenAI also used its DevDay event to unveil a new set of “always-on” artificial intelligence agents called Dots, which feature cute, emoji-like avatars and serve their users as 24/7 digital assistants that can perform an expanded range of tasks.

articles.title: AMD compra startup de IA que cria mundos 3D por R$ 43 bilhões • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
AMD compra startup de IA que cria mundos 3D por R$ 43 bilhões
World Labs desenvolve modelos capazes de simular ambientes tridimensionais. Cofundadora e CEO, Fei-Fei Li vai integrar a AMD como cientista-chefe.
A AMD comunicou a aquisição da World Labs, startup de inteligência artificial cofundada pela pesquisadora Fei-Fei Li. A operação está avaliada em aproximadamente US$ 8,2 bilhões (cerca de R$ 43 bilhões, em conversão direta). O negócio ainda depende de aprovações regulatórias antes de ser concluído, o que a AMD espera que aconteça até o fim de 2026.
Com a compra, a fabricante de chips pretende incorporar à empresa uma equipe especializada em modelos de IA e usar esse conhecimento no desenvolvimento de futuros produtos de hardware, software e infraestrutura.
Fundada em 2024, a World Labs trabalha com inteligência espacial, desenvolvendo modelos de IA capazes de gerar, reconstruir e simular ambientes tridimensionais interativos a partir de comandos de texto, imagens e vídeos. A startup também pesquisa tecnologias voltadas ao aprendizado de robôs e à criação de ambientes de simulação.
A proposta vai além dos grandes modelos de linguagem usados em serviços como chatbots. Sistemas desse tipo podem ser úteis em áreas como robótica, simulação e aplicações de IA capazes de interagir com ambientes reais.
A cofundadora e CEO da World Labs, Fei-Fei Li, é uma das pesquisadoras mais conhecidas da área de visão computacional e assumirá os cargos de vice-presidente executiva e cientista-chefe da AMD após a conclusão do negócio. A equipe da World Labs continuará trabalhando no desenvolvimento de modelos de inteligência artificial dentro da AMD.
A aquisição ocorre em um momento de expansão dos negócios da AMD ligados à IA. Na semana passada, a companhia chegou a superar US$ 1 trilhão em valor de mercado (cerca de R$ 5,2 trilhões), impulsionada pela expectativa de crescimento das vendas de produtos para data centers.
A empresa também vem fechando acordos para ampliar o uso de suas GPUs no treinamento e na execução de modelos. Em julho, a AMD fechou uma parceria com a Anthropic que prevê até 2 gigawatts de capacidade computacional baseada em chips Instinct MI450.
A World Labs acrescenta outra frente a essa estratégia. Em vez de atuar apenas na infraestrutura usada para executar modelos, a AMD passa a ter dentro de casa uma equipe dedicada à pesquisa e criação de sistemas de IA.
Segundo a CEO da empresa de chips, Lisa Su, compreender como esses modelos estão evoluindo pode ajudar a empresa a definir o desenvolvimento das próximas gerações de hardware, software e sistemas.

articles.title: Il sert aussi l'hiver : ce ventilateur de plafond connecté Create passe sous les 90€
articles.text:
Le Create Windcalm S réunit un moteur DC, un éclairage LED à trois températures et un pilotage en Wi-Fi sur 112 cm d’envergure. Sa fonction hiver lui trouve un rôle dès l’allumage du chauffage, ce qui change la façon de juger un ventilateur acheté fin septembre.
Acheter un ventilateur à l’automne peut sembler à contretemps. C’est pourtant le moment où l’on installe un appareil de plafond sans se presser, avant que les premières chaleurs ne transforment la pose en urgence. Pendant les Jours Flash Prime, Amazon propose le Create Windcalm S en version Wi-Fi avec éclairage à 89,95 € contre un prix conseillé de 105,95 €, soit 16 € d’économie.
Ce modèle de 112 cm vise les petites pièces, jusqu’à 10 m² selon le fabricant. Il s’adresse à ceux qui veulent un ventilateur et un plafonnier au même endroit, pilotables depuis le lit comme depuis le téléphone.
Le ventilateur de plafond Create Windcalm S, en version Wi-Fi avec éclairage, est affiché à 89,95 € au lieu de 105,95 € sur Amazon pendant les Jours Flash Prime.
Pourquoi choisir le Create Windcalm S ?
- Un appareil utile toute l’année : La fonction été-hiver inverse le sens de rotation des pales. En hiver, le flux redistribue dans la pièce l’air chaud du chauffage accumulé au plafond, ce qui donne un rôle à l’appareil bien avant l’été prochain.
- Deux façons de le commander : La télécommande fournie gère les six vitesses, la lumière et la minuterie. Le Wi-Fi ajoute le pilotage depuis l’application Create, pratique pour lancer la ventilation avant d’entrer dans la pièce.
- Un plafonnier intégré : Son kit LED propose trois températures de couleur, de 2 700 à 4 000 K selon Create. Il peut donc prendre la place du luminaire existant sans ajouter de lampe dans la pièce.
Pour profiter du Prime Day, n'oubliez pas de devenir membre Amazon Prime. Vous bénéficiez d'un essai gratuit de 30 jours, c'est donc le bon moment pour tester.
Une chambre ou un bureau, pas un séjour
Avec son moteur DC de 40 W et ses six vitesses, le Windcalm S fait varier son débit de 82 à 180 m³/min d’après la fiche Create. La fiche annonce 50 dB, sans préciser à quelle vitesse : pour une chambre, les réglages bas sont ceux à privilégier. La minuterie, réglable de 1 à 4 heures selon Amazon, coupe l’appareil une fois endormi. Ses trois pales en ABS, certifiées IP44, sont données par le fabricant pour un usage intérieur comme extérieur.
Il vise d’abord une chambre, une chambre d’enfant ou un bureau à domicile de 10 m² au plus. Au-delà, Create oriente vers le Windcalm M de 132 cm, prévu pour 10 à 25 m², ou le L de 152 cm. Le modèle convient mal aux plafonds en pente, que sa fiche déclare incompatibles, et sa hauteur n’est pas réglable. Il demande enfin un raccordement électrique au plafond : si l’exercice vous intimide, prévoyez l’intervention d’un électricien.
Plutôt qu’un ventilateur sur pied ?
Face à un ventilateur sur pied ou colonne, le Windcalm S libère le sol et fait office d’éclairage, mais il se fixe une fois pour toutes et ne suit pas d’une pièce à l’autre. Il ne refroidit pas l’air non plus : comme tout ventilateur, il le brasse, ce qui ne remplace pas un climatiseur pendant une canicule. Si percer ou raccorder le plafond est exclu chez vous, notre comparatif des meilleurs ventilateurs recense des modèles sur pied, colonne ou sans pales, comme le Rowenta Turbo Silence Extreme ou le Dyson Cool AM07.
✅ Les points forts
- Fonction été-hiver qui lui donne un usage dès cet automne
- Pilotage par télécommande ou par application en Wi-Fi
- Éclairage LED intégré à trois températures de couleur
- Moteur DC de 40 W et six vitesses
- Pales légères en ABS, certifiées IP44
❌ Les limites
- Dimensionné pour les pièces de 10 m² au plus
- Intensité lumineuse non réglable, selon la fiche Amazon
- Incompatible avec les plafonds en pente, hauteur fixe
- Raccordement électrique au plafond à prévoir
Le Windcalm S existe en plusieurs coloris et versions sur la même fiche Amazon : vérifiez que celle affichée à 89,95 € est bien la blanche effet bois clair, avec Wi-Fi et éclairage.
À 89,95 €, le Create Windcalm S réunit pour 16 € de moins un ventilateur, un plafonnier et une commande connectée, une combinaison cohérente pour une petite pièce. Son intérêt ne dépend pas de la météo : le mode hiver l’occupe dès l’allumage du chauffage, et il sera déjà en place quand les températures remonteront. La remise reste modeste, calculée sur un prix conseillé plutôt que sur un historique de prix.
Il s’adresse à ceux qui équipent une chambre ou un bureau de 10 m² ou moins, sous un plafond droit. Pour un séjour, les tailles M ou L seront plus adaptées, et dans un logement où percer le plafond est exclu, un modèle sur pied reste la solution la plus simple. Avant de commander, mesurez la pièce et vérifiez votre plafond : ces deux points, plus que la remise, diront si ce Windcalm S vous convient.

Best for: Professionals who needs huge amounts of desktop storage for backups, photographs, videos and other large files without installing an internal drive.
The deal: The Seagate 24TB Expansion External Desktop Hard Drive is now $690 (was $830) at Best Buy.
Why it matters: A single 24TB drive provides enough capacity to store large archives and backups that might otherwise be spread across several smaller drives or hosted online.
Today's best Seagate external HDD deal
This external desktop hard drive provides 24TB storage, USB 3.0 connectivity, Windows and Mac compatibility, Toolkit backup software, Rescue Data Recovery Services, an AC power adapter and one-year warranty.

Seagate has proved a strong storage maker during our tests, so this one's an easy recommendation if you need a hard drive.

The $139.97 reduction from $829.96 to $689.99 works out at almost 17% off, bringing the cost down to around 2.9 cents per GB. That sounds like a great saving, but context is important here. You can wait for storage prices to improve or for a better, bigger promotion. This is a desktop hard drive rather than a portable model so requires the supplied 18W power adapter as well as a USB connection. You can't simply plug it into your laptop and use it anywhere.

articles.title: Take-Two Sends Cease-and-Desist to GTA 5 Switch Port Modder, Android Version Canceled
articles.text:
Tuesday, September 29th 2026
	
									
	
	
	
Take-Two Sends Cease-and-Desist to GTA 5 Switch Port Modder, Android Version Canceled
Paralympics Productions, the modding group that got GTA 5 running natively on the original Nintendo Switch, is shutting down on October 3. Project lead M0jso announced on X that Take-Two Interactive sent him a cease-and-desist letter, after which he was left with no choice but to shut down his projects. The Android port he was working on after the Switch build is canceled as well, and he says nobody will take over the project or continue it under a new name. M0jso also says the source code won't be released, since that could bring more legal trouble. Apparently, he thinks Take-Two has solid grounds and that he probably wouldn't win in court. 
Both ports reportedly relied on GTA 5 source code that leaked in 2023. However, he hasn't publicly detailed the legal claims, so it's not clear exactly what the letter targets. The timing seems to line up with Rockstar's move to tighten its mod guidelines this month. The new rules tell fans not to modify Rockstar games to run on consoles or other platforms where the company hasn't officially released them. Moreover, M0jso also took a jab at Rockstar over those rules about a week before the shutdown. Of course, we can't say for sure that's what triggered the letter, but it probably didn't help. For now, Android users are back to Winlator-style compatibility tools or streaming, and I doubt anyone will try a native port again any time soon.

articles.title: OpenAI's Codex gets reusable cloud environments that follow developers across devices - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
OpenAI’s Codex gets reusable cloud environments that follow developers across devices
OpenAI Group PBC today rolled out reusable cloud environments for its Codex coding agent, giving developers a saved project configuration they can work from across devices.
Announced at the company’s DevDay conference, the release targets the preparation that comes before an agent writes a line of code. A cloud environment does that work once. Each new task starts from that saved setup, with the project’s dependencies already installed.
Developers begin by connecting a repository from GitHub Inc. Codex reads the code to see which software versions the project relies on and drafts the install script from what it finds. Startup checks for the project’s services come out of the same pass, and OpenAI’s documentation says any changes are made in conversation with Codex.
Once an environment is published, each task launched from it gets its own virtual machine and keeps working while the developer’s computer sleeps. Changes not yet sent back to the repository stay with the task, so it can be reopened later from a phone or a browser without losing them. Dependency caches survive the background refreshes that keep the repository current.
OpenAI is also pitching the environments at teams that want every developer working from the same approved configuration. After one is shared with a ChatGPT workspace, colleagues can run their own tasks from it. Access to a shared environment does not extend to anyone else’s tasks or to editing the setup. Enterprise administrators hand out that editing permission separately.
For the credentials a project needs, cloud environments support standard environment variables and a second type OpenAI calls network secrets. A program that uses a network secret sees only a placeholder, with a proxy inserting the real value as traffic heads to a domain on the allow list. Individual users of a shared environment can be asked to supply their own values from a personal account. Internet access defaults to a preset of common package registries, and developers can open it wider.
Codex has handled tasks in the cloud since it debuted as a research preview inside ChatGPT in May 2025. Codex Security Cloud, another DevDay launch, takes the same approach to security work. It scans GitHub repositories on a schedule and prepares fixes while the developer’s machine is off.
Access to cloud environments is rolling out to ChatGPT Plus and Pro subscribers, and Business, Enterprise, Edu and Healthcare workspaces get it too. Plus accounts run on the smallest virtual machines, with half the processors and memory of the Pro, Business and Enterprise tiers.
By default, a task’s state can be recovered for up to seven days after it was last used. Codex cannot yet work with repositories on GitLab Inc. or on self-hosted GitHub Enterprise Server, and computer and browser use are also unsupported in cloud environments.

articles.title: Anthropic gasta mais dinheiro do que fatura para bancar IA • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Anthropic gasta mais dinheiro do que fatura para bancar IA
Dona do Claude teve receita de US$ 4,6 bilhões no último ano, mas prejuízo operacional foi praticamente o dobro.
Apesar do consumo abrangente pelo público, a corrida pela liderança no setor da IA ainda está saindo muito cara. Para a Anthropic, a receita de US$ 4,6 bilhões (aproximadamente R$ 24 bilhões) registrada no ano passado ficou longe de ser suficiente para dar lucro: o prejuízo operacional foi quase o dobro, US$ 8,06 bilhões (R$ 42,2 bilhões).
Os números são do prospecto da futura Oferta Pública Inicial (IPO, na sigla em inglês) da startup, responsável pelo Claude, que pode atingir um valor de superior a US$ 2 trilhões (R$ 10 trilhões). A oferta inicial é o momento em que uma companhia passa a vender suas ações ao público. Tanto a Anthropic quanto a OpenAI, dona do ChatGPT, pretendem fazê-la no futuro.
A receita da empresa cresceu cerca de 12 vezes no ano passado, mas os gastos também subiram bastante. Foram US$ 7,33 bilhões (R$ 38,3 bilhões) desembolsados em computação e infraestrutura, mais que o triplo do valor registrado em 2024.
O documento, obtido pela Reuters, mostra que essas despesas são mais da metade dos US$ 12,65 bilhões (R$ 66,2 bilhões) gastos pela companhia em sua operação durante o período. O resultado líquido das despesas atingiu US$ 42 bilhões (R$ 219,9 bilhões) no ano passado, sendo a maior parte do valor em encargos contábeis que podem ser convertidos em ações no futuro.
O principal peso sobre a conta está na infraestrutura. Treinar sistemas e disponibilizá-los para os clientes exige maior capacidade de computação, como investimentos em chips, concorridos por várias empresas, além de servidores.
A conta para a Anthropic não deve diminuir tão cedo. Segundo a agência Reuters, a empresa já teria assumido US$ 518 bilhões (R$ 2,7 trilhões) em compromissos futuros relacionados a provedores de nuvem e infraestrutura, valor que deve ser pago no decorrer dos próximos anos.
Em 31 de dezembro de 2025, a companhia tinha US$ 20,28 bilhões (R$ 106 bilhões) em caixa e em aplicações de curto prazo. Parte dos recursos vem de parceiros, como Amazon e Google, que investiram bilhões e fornecem tecnologia para a empresa.
O prospecto também chama a atenção para a concentração de clientes. Cerca de 25% da receita de 2025 da companhia veio de apenas dois clientes, e grande parte dos compradores corporativos não está presa a contratos de longo prazo — eles podem sair a qualquer momento e desfalcar os ganhos.
Por conta disso, a abertura de capital tem se tornado a grande solução. A empresa avalia uma oferta que poderia colocá-la na bolsa com valor de mercado superior a US$ 2 trilhões, segundo fontes ouvidas pela agência. Isso é quase o dobro dos US$ 965 bilhões (R$ 5 trilhões) estimados em maio.
A listagem pode acontecer após as eleições de meio de mandato dos Estados Unidos, que ocorrem em novembro. A companhia ainda não confirmou publicamente uma data para o IPO, que também deve ser feito pela OpenAI, sua principal concorrente no setor.
A empresa de Sam Altman também submeteu as documentações iniciais à Comissão de Valores Mobiliários dos Estados Unidos (SEC, na sigla em inglês) no começo de junho. O processo, porém, não deve ocorrer antes de 2027, disse o executivo neste mês.

articles.title: Papelera de WhatsApp: cómo vaciarla y qué archivos se pueden borrar del celular
articles.text:
La papelera de WhatsApp funciona como un espacio de almacenamiento intermedio en el que se acumulan fotos, videos, audios y documentos que parecían eliminados, pero todavía ocupan memoria en el celular. Revisarla permite identificar contenido innecesario y liberar espacio sin borrar conversaciones completas.
Para encontrarla, hay que ingresar a WhatsApp, tocar “Ajustes”, ir a “Almacenamiento y datos” y seleccionar “Administración de almacenamiento”.
PUBLICIDAD
Allí aparece debajo de la sección “Revisa y elimina elementos”, desde donde se pueden revisar los archivos que permanecen guardados en la aplicación.
Para borrar contenido, se debe pulsar “Seleccionar”, elegir los archivos deseados y tocar el ícono de la papelera. Esta sección también permite recuperar un archivo eliminado por error antes de que se borre de forma definitiva.
Qué se puede borrar de la papelera de WhatsApp
En esta sección se pueden eliminar fotos, videos, audios y documentos que siguen almacenados en el teléfono. Con el uso diario de la aplicación, esos archivos pueden acumularse y ocupar una cantidad considerable de espacio.
Los videos suelen ser uno de los contenidos que más memoria consumen, especialmente cuando fueron enviados en grupos activos o se descargaron de forma automática. Los documentos, los audios y los GIF también pueden aumentar el espacio que utiliza WhatsApp.
PUBLICIDAD
Antes de borrar archivos, conviene revisarlos para evitar eliminar fotos, videos o documentos que todavía puedan ser necesarios. Una limpieza periódica ayuda a mantener la aplicación más liviana y a optimizar el rendimiento del celular.
Qué otras formas hay de ahorrar espacio en WhatsApp
Los grupos con mucha actividad suelen concentrar una gran cantidad de archivos multimedia. Revisar los chats más activos y eliminar contenido pesado o repetido permite reducir el espacio que ocupa la aplicación.
Es posible modificar la configuración de descarga automática de archivos. En “Almacenamiento y datos”, WhatsApp permite desactivar la descarga automática de determinados contenidos, como videos o documentos, para evitar que se acumulen sin que el usuario lo advierta.
PUBLICIDAD
Las copias de seguridad de las conversaciones también pueden incluir archivos multimedia y ocupar espacio tanto en el teléfono como en la nube. Revisar la configuración de los respaldos ayuda a evitar que crezcan de manera sostenida.
Por qué WhatsApp consume espacio en el celular
WhatsApp guarda los archivos que se reciben y envían en los chats, incluidos fotos, videos, notas de voz, documentos, GIF y stickers. Cuanto mayor es la actividad en grupos y conversaciones, más contenido puede quedar almacenado en el dispositivo.
El problema puede extenderse a otros elementos del teléfono. Eliminar aplicaciones que no se usan, borrar contenido duplicado de la galería y mover fotos o videos a servicios en la nube, como Google Fotos o iCloud, son opciones para recuperar capacidad de almacenamiento.
PUBLICIDAD
Además, los datos temporales de las apps pueden ocupar varios gigabytes con el tiempo. Limpiar la caché de las aplicaciones permite liberar espacio y mejorar el funcionamiento general del celular.
Qué nuevas funciones hay en WhatsApp
WhatsApp incorporó nuevas funciones para mejorar las llamadas, reforzar la seguridad de las cuentas y facilitar la gestión de conversaciones desde distintos dispositivos.
Entre las actualizaciones más recientes, la aplicación permite hacer y recibir llamadas de audio y video desde WhatsApp Web, tanto individuales como grupales. La versión para navegadores incluye opciones como compartir pantalla, enviar reacciones, consultar el historial de llamadas y acceder a contactos favoritos.
La plataforma también habilitó la transferencia de llamadas activas entre dispositivos, una sala de espera para enlaces de llamadas grupales, video en alta definición desde los primeros segundos y una herramienta de supresión de ruido para mejorar el audio en entornos ruidosos.
PUBLICIDAD
En los grupos, WhatsApp sumó encuestas con horario de cierre, la posibilidad de ocultar los nombres de quienes votan y una opción para editar la pregunta durante los primeros 15 minutos. También incorporó la mención @all para notificar a todos los integrantes de un chat.
Para liberar memoria, la aplicación permite localizar y eliminar archivos grandes desde cada conversación, sin borrar el historial del chat. Además, los usuarios pueden tener dos cuentas activas en un mismo iPhone y transferir el historial entre dispositivos iOS y Android.

articles.title: Spotify en panne : que faire si votre musique refuse de se lancer ?
articles.text:
Les signalements s’accumulent autour du service de streaming musical ce mardi après-midi. Pour les utilisateurs touchés, les contenus déjà téléchargés peuvent offrir une solution de secours.
Spotify laisse une partie de ses utilisateurs sans musique ce 29 septembre 2026. Peu après 16 heures, Downdetector relevait un pic de plus de 3 500 signalements avec un compteur en forte hausse. Si votre application refuse de fonctionner, vous êtes donc loin d’être seul.
Des erreurs et des difficultés de connexion
Les plaintes concernent notamment l’application et l’accès au compte. Certains utilisateurs rencontrent un message indiquant qu’un problème est survenu et les invitant à réessayer. La cause des perturbations et le délai de rétablissement restent à préciser.
Le mode hors connexion peut sauver votre playlist
Vous pouvez commencer par fermer puis relancer l’application. Si elle reste accessible, les abonnés Premium peuvent essayer le mode hors connexion pour écouter leurs albums et playlists déjà téléchargés. Les utilisateurs gratuits disposent de cette possibilité pour les podcasts enregistrés au préalable.
Évitez en revanche de désinstaller Spotify dans la précipitation : l’opération supprime les téléchargements, qu’il faudra ensuite récupérer. Autant préserver cette solution de secours pendant la panne.

articles.title: The Polar Street X is designed for city dwellers, but I’m not sure Polar has given them what they want
articles.text:
TechRadar Verdict
The Polar Street X is a mid-range smartwatch that is successful in delivering a number of high-end features, but solid implementation is not present across the board. I was disappointed by the user interface, and navigation around menus using the buttons was unintuitive and difficult. More positively, the watch offers an extensive set of metrics across training and health with an accurate GPS that matched our benchmark in testing. I only wish the GPS locked on more quickly. The Street X is aimed at people who live in the city, but I can’t help but think they’d be expecting more finesse and style.
Reasons to buy
- +Accurate GPS
- +Good range of activity tracking
- +Solid heart rate measurements
- +Robust design
Reasons to avoid
- -Over chunky buttons
- -Long button presses are frustrating
- -Poorly designed user interface
Why you can trust TechRadar
Polar Street X: One minute review
Polar has released its latest sports smartwatch, the Street X. With a brief to create an ‘urban sports watch for those who live, work, and train in the city’, Polar has produced a chunky G-Shock-style watch that is tough, lightweight, and ‘always ready’ to go.
The rather basic design and poorly implemented user interface stand in contrast to gorgeous and sleek alternatives such as the Apple Watch Ultra 3 and the Samsung Galaxy Watch 8. The Street X might offer a 50m water rating and military-grade durability (perhaps a little redundant for city dwellers), but this comes at the expense of a design that is properly thought through and finessed.
Thankfully, there are no issues with the bright 1.28-inch AMOLED display that's covered by tough Gorilla Glass or, indeed, GPS accuracy that keeps up with more expensive smartwatches, including the Garmin Tactix 8.
Solid performance continues with mapping tools that allow for route navigation and mixed-terrain training, although GPS tracking often takes upwards of a minute to lock in. In a day and age when we expect instant results, this is frustrating.
Based on our experience with the Street X, we don’t expect it to feature in our best smartwatches guide. Accuracy aside, its running features can’t keep up with Garmin’s dedicated offerings.
Polar Street X: Specifications

| Price | $249.99 USD / £219 UK / $429.99 AUS | 
| Dimensions | 45mm wide, 13.8mm thick | 
| Weight | 48g with strap. 28g without strap |

| Display | 1.28-inch AMOLED Gorilla Glass | 
| GPS | GPS, Galileo, BeiDou, QZSS | 
| Battery life | Performance training mode: 43 hours. Smartwatch mode: 10 days | 
| Connection | Bluetooth® LE | 
| Water resistance | WR50 | 
Polar Street X: Price and availability
- $249.99 USD / £219 UK / $429.99 AUS
- Pricier than expected, given the materials and specs
- Cheaper alternatives exist from more established brands
The Polar Street X sits alongside the Finnish brand’s cheaper Pacer range, rather than the more expensive Vantage and Grit series’. . At $249.99 USD / £219 UK / $429.99 AUS, it is significantly cheaper than the Pacer Pro and only a little more expensive than the Pacer. The watch ships in three different colors: Night Black, Snow White, Forest Green.
One of the best alternatives, also boasting an AMOLED display and onboard GPS, is the Amazfit Active 3 Premium. Priced at $169.99 / £169.90, we were so impressed that we awarded it an incredible five-stars.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
If you’re a Garmin fan, then the slightly pricier Forerunner 170 at $299 / £259.99 / AU$479 is worth a look. We found it to be “extremely accurate” during treadmill tests “despite packing Garmin's older heart rate sensing technology.”
- Value score 4/5
Polar Street X: Design
- Chunky shockproof design with a budget feel
- Fiddly strap but a comfortable fit
- Very poorly designed user interface
The Polar Street X boasts a classic shockproof design with a five-button configuration similar to the best Garmin watches. They are chunky and clunky, and accessing the top left side button to go backwards through menus is incredibly awkward for a right-hander wearing the watch on the left wrist. I also wasn’t a fan of the long button presses that were required to avoid accidental presses. In practice, these were a second or two longer than they needed to be.
Both the case and bezel are made of ‘bio-based plastic’, which means renewable biomass sources were used rather than petrochemical alternatives. It’s also robust enough to protect the internal components from damage even when dropped. Durability credentials include a 50 meter water resistance rating and MIL-STD-810H testing that demonstrates the Street X’s ability to withstand high and low temperatures, rain, sand, dust, and vibration.
The AMOLED display isn’t huge; in fact, the 1.28-inch diameter felt a little restrictive, especially considering the poorly designed user interface, which fails to take advantage of the full screen. Menu items are also curved at the bottom of the interface, but they don’t follow the circle shape of the case, which is rather jarring.
The 416px resolution delivers a clear image and is protected by Gorilla Glass, which is ideal for users who are prone to dropping their smartwatches. The screen is touch-enabled, features ‘always on’ functionality, and features an ambient light sensor.
I often think one of the most overlooked elements of a smartwatch design is the strap, and Polar has fallen foul of that too. The strap includes an awkward catch design, which I found incredibly fiddly. That said, once the watch is securely positioned on the wrist, it is comfortable to wear, even for long periods of time.
- Design Score: 3/5
Polar Street X: Features
- Extensive training and health tracking
- Navigation features including route guidance
- Smart features and utilities for a broader smartwatch experience
At the heart of the Polar Street X is a set of tracking tools for training, including Training Load Pro for making sure your body doesn’t become overstrained. For runners there is a Running Program feature where you can select one of four running events: 5K, 10K, half marathon, or marathon, and get a personalized, adaptive training plan that fits you and your goals. This is a simple but well-implemented solution for keeping you on track.
The Street X offers all the health tracking that you would expect, including continuous heart rate, step count, and calorie burn. Beyond this, Polar has packed the watch with a skin temperature sensor for early indication of fever, inflammation, or impending illness. Polar also says that “women can use these skin temperature insights to better understand which phase of their menstrual cycle they are in." Skin temperature sensors are common in wearables now, as devices like the Apple Watch and Oura Ring use them to calculate cycle tracking and help predict illness.
The features that set the Street X apart from super-budget alternatives relate to mapping and navigation. With built-in GPS, users get the benefit of route guidance, breadcrumb trails, and elevation profiles. The ability to return back to your start point either by the same route or beeline means you can pick whichever option suits you when you get to your end point. There’s also a built-in LED flashlight, altimeter, and compass.
- Features Score: 4/5
Polar Street X: Performance
- Accurate GPS, but signal lock-on takes far too long
- Extensive metrics help athletes improve
- Training features are nice to have, but serious runners will want more
My experience of the Street X smartwatch was a bit of a mixed bag, with some elements performing brilliantly but others struggling. There’s no denying that it offers a solid set of features that go beyond some budget alternatives, but the implementation of these is far from perfect.
Take the onboard GPS as an example. Given the price, I wasn’t expecting incredible things, but having to regularly wait over a minute for a GPS lock left me underwhelmed. That said, once the GPS signal was found, it was as accurate as one of our trusty benchmarks, the Garmin Tactix 8.
The watch offers over 170 sports and activities as well as the ability to manage training loads, strain and tolerance. I primarily used running, cycling, and walking modes, and even though all the required data and functionality were present, I found it difficult to navigate around, even after a number of times using the watch.
The Street X features basic maps with a range of navigation tools. I was impressed by the inclusion of ‘Back to Start’ navigation with the ability to choose either ‘Via Beeline’ or ‘Via Same Route’. The maps clearly display the necessary turn-by-turn directions, so getting lost is next to impossible.
After exercising, an extensive set of metrics, including energy used, pace, cadence, and speed zones, can be viewed on the watch, although they are far easier to digest in the Polar Flow app. It’s also possible to choose from a drop-down list of options to record how the exercise felt, but you can only add more detailed notes using the app.
The Street X offers optical heart rate measurements as well as heart rate zones and heart rate variability. Heart rate readings matched my dedicated heart rate tracker.
In terms of smart features, the Street X packs everything you’d expect from a mid-range smartwatch, including notifications, weather, Find My Phone, and music controls, although for the last, it is only controlling your phone’s music, not anything loaded on or streaming from the watch itself. The only smart feature I was left craving was the ability to reply to texts.
The watch has a built-in LED flashlight, which I used to navigate around my poorly lit neighbourhood, although it wasn’t really bright enough to light my way. And in reality it was no stronger than the torch on my iPhone, so the watch’s flashlight was surplus to my requirements.
The battery performance sits at 10 days for general use and 43 hours for constant GPS. This is reasonable for a sub-$250/£250 smartwatch. Recharging from empty to full took me 70 minutes, although 0-50% took only 30 minutes.
- Performance score: 4/5
Polar Street X: Scorecard
| Category | Comment | Score | 
| Value | A little overpriced compared to the competition but still relatively good value. | 4/5 | 
| Design | A G-Shock-esque design with robust credentials. Unfortunately, it lacks finesse. | 3/5 | 
| Features | A solid set of features including dedicated running tools and onboard GPS | 4/5 | 
| Performance | GPS accuracy is a standout, but signal lock-on takes longer than it should. | 4/5 | 
Polar Street X: Should I buy?
Buy it if...
You’re looking for an affordable and accurate GPS tracker
For the price, I was impressed by the results.
You like shockproof design and don’t mind that plastic feel
Despite feeling cheap, it’s both solid and robust.
Don't buy it if...
You care about well-implemented design
The Polar Street X interface lacks finesse.
You like sleek smartwatches that look great on the wrist
With cheap materials and a basic design, far more attractive alternatives exist.
Also consider
Amazfit Active 3 Premium
A cheaper alternative but still with fantastic specs, including a bright AMOLED display and GPS tracking.
Garmin Forerunner 170
Offering accurate measurements, the Forerunner 165 is a highly rated, budget-friendly solution for runners who love Garmin smartwatches.
How I tested the Polar Street X
I wore the Polar Street X smartwatch almost continuously for a month. During this time I went on a number of runs, cycles, and walks while comparing the unit to the Garmin Tactix 8 and Huawei Watch Ultimate 2. I also compared the heart rate measurements with a dedicated heart rate tracker.
First reviewed: September 2026
Writer, app-hoarder, and professional "low battery" enthusiast. Paul spends his days testing wearables so you don’t have to, and his nights wondering if his sleep tracker is judging him. He’s fascinated by the tech that claims to make us better humans—and if it’s wearable, downloadable, or requires a firmware update, he has thoughts on it.
With over 20 years of experience and a first-class Computer Science degree, Paul has navigated the front lines of the tech and creative industries. His work has been published internationally and appears regularly in Digital Camera World and Creative Bloq.

articles.title: Mapa? Não: 90% dos brasileiros priorizam internet em viagens • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Mapa? Não: 90% dos brasileiros priorizam internet em viagens
Pesquisa da Airalo mostra que conexão móvel é o item que não pode faltar em viagens internacionais. 52% já ficaram em situação desconfortável por falta de internet.
Viajar para outro país costumava exigir um mapa dobrado no bolso, às vezes um dicionário com o idioma local e o endereço da estadia anotado em algum lugar. Mas isso mudou: para 90% dos brasileiros que viajam ao exterior, a conexão móvel é o item essencial durante uma viagem internacional.
O índice supera a média de 80% registrada nos outros mercados analisados pela Airalo, especializada na venda de eSIMs, em parceria com a empresa de pesquisa de dados YouGov. Mapas e transporte continuam importantes, mas fazem parte do conjunto de ferramentas que os viajantes acessam pelo celular durante o trajeto.
Quando o celular está à mão, mas a internet não funciona, o cenário se complica. Os brasileiros registram 8,22 em uma escala de 10 para o nível de ansiedade provocado por precisar do telefone sem ter acesso à rede. É a maior média entre todos os países pesquisados.
A falta de conexão também pode prolongar situações desconfortáveis. Cerca de 52% dos brasileiros dizem já ter permanecido em uma situação desconfortável ou insegura por mais tempo do que gostariam porque estavam sem internet. Entre os exemplos citados estão não conseguir carregar um mapa ou solicitar um transporte.
Por outro lado, estar conectado parece ampliar os limites do passeio: 90% afirmam que uma conexão estável dá mais liberdade para explorar destinos e sair das rotas turísticas tradicionais. Para 81%, ter acesso garantido à internet aumentaria a disposição para visitar um destino que poderiam evitar por questões de segurança.
O celular ganha importância especialmente quando a viagem é feita sozinho. No Brasil, 60% dos entrevistados afirmam já ter usado ferramentas de segurança que dependem de conexão constante, como o compartilhamento de localização com familiares e amigos.
Os dados compõem o estudo Safe When Travel, que ouviu viajantes dos Estados Unidos, Alemanha, Canadá, Reino Unido, Itália, França, Austrália, Brasil e México. Por aqui, foram entrevistadas 502 pessoas que viajaram ao exterior nos últimos dois anos. A pesquisa online foi realizada entre 5 e 24 de agosto de 2026.

articles.title: EliseAI raises $350M to enhance its AI work automation suite - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
EliseAI raises $350M to enhance its AI work automation suite
EliseAI, a startup that develops artificial intelligence tools for real-estate companies and healthcare providers, has raised $350 million in funding.
Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer jointly led the round. EliseAI said today that they were joined by Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan, Sapphire Ventures and Navitas Capital. The company is now valued at $4 billion.
EliseAI, officially Elise A.I. Technologies Corp., launched in 2017 with a focus on the rental housing market. It offers a customer relationship management platform that property managers can use to store prospect data. It also extracts key information from a company’s interactions with existing residents. A marketing automation engine harnesses that data to tailor promotional materials for each lead.
The second pillar of EliseAI’s real-estate automation toolkit is called the Maintenance App. It’s a mobile client that automatically routes property repair requests to technicians. According to EliseAI, the app finds the most suitable professional for each project based on factors such as availability and the skill sets the work requires. A monitoring dashboard enables property managers to track the progress of repairs.
Earlier this month, EliseAI expanded its real-estate feature set with an AI assistant called Apollo. It automates chores such as sending follow-ups to leads who attended a property tour. Additionally, workers can use it as an information retrieval tool. Apollo surfaces property management best practices and data points such as the average cost of outstanding maintenance projects.
The company disclosed today that its platform supports the management of more than one in six U.S. apartments. The company’s healthcare platform, meanwhile, is used by over 3,500 organizations. Its customers range from small clinics to hospitals.
EliseAI provides a chatbot that can schedule medical appointments and answer patient questions. It says the software is capable of processing up to 95% of inbound inquiries. Following a doctor’s visit, EliseAI automates tasks such as sending prescription reminders.
The platform can also perform some of the back-office work involved in managing patient visits. It ingests patient documents and syncs key information to a healthcare organization’s electronic health record, or EHR, system. That reduces the need for manual data entry, which saves time and lowers the risk of human error.
“These industries are the most complex, the most bespoke, the most entrenched, and the hardest — but they’re also the most important,” co-founder and Chief Executive Officer Minna Song wrote in a blog post. “And they won’t absorb this technology without a tremendous act of building.”
EliseAI will use its funding round to extend its automation features. The company also plans to hire more engineers, software deployment professionals and salespeople.

articles.title: Claude est en panne : Anthropic confirme un incident qui touche une large partie de ses services
articles.text:
Claude connaît une panne importante ce mardi après-midi. Le problème touche le chatbot d’Anthropic, mais aussi Claude Code, Claude Cowork, sa plateforme et certaines requêtes envoyées à son API.
Claude a bien malgré lui décidé de compliquer la journée d’une partie de ses utilisateurs. Anthropic a confirmé, ce mardi 29 septembre, être victime d'un incident qui ne concerne pas seulement les conversations sur Claude.ai. En effet, plusieurs outils de son écosystème rencontrent aussi des erreurs ou des performances dégradées. De quoi affecter aussi bien le grand public que les développeurs qui s’appuient sur les services de l’entreprise.
Plusieurs services de Claude sont touchés par une panne
Sur sa page de statut, Anthropic indique enquêter sur des problèmes affectant Claude.ai, platform.claude.com, l’API Claude, Claude Code et Claude Cowork. L’entreprise a commencé à signaler l’incident à 14h21 UTC, soit 16h21 en France métropolitaine, avant d’élargir quelques minutes plus tard la liste des services concernés.
Tous ne sont cependant pas touchés avec la même intensité, peut-on dire. À 16h36, Claude.ai, Claude Code et Claude Cowork étaient classés en panne partielle, tandis que la console destinée aux développeurs et l’API affichaient des performances dégradées.
À 16h41, un nouveau message a été publié par Anthropic. « Nous avons appliqué une mesure corrective et le taux d’erreur a considérablement diminué. Certaines tentatives de connexion, actions sur le compte et sessions Claude Code et Cowork échouent encore. Nous continuons de travailler à une solution complète. »
Ce que les utilisateurs de Claude peuvent rencontrer
Pour les utilisateurs, l’incident peut prendre plusieurs formes. Anthropic mentionne des requêtes qui échouent, des difficultés pour charger ou envoyer une conversation, ainsi que des demandes inattendues de reconnexion. Une nouvelle tentative peut parfois permettre de passer, précise l’entreprise, sans garantir que le problème disparaisse pour autant.
L’incident ne signifie donc pas que Claude, qui vient tout juste de lancer pour ses utilisateurs le modèle Sonnet 5.5, est totalement inaccessible. Mais à l’heure de la capture fournie, l’incident était toujours indiqué comme non résolu, et l’entreprise poursuivait ses investigations.

articles.title: Meta reveals new Enterprise Platform to help businesses harness its AI
articles.text:
Meta reveals new Enterprise Platform to help businesses harness its AI power
Unsurprisingly, Meta wants businesses to use more AI
- Meta unveils new platform to provide businesses access to a range of AI tools
- Offering includes access to Muse agent, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code
- Zuckerberg announces new Chief Enterprise Platform Officer, poached from MongoDB
Moving beyond simply automating and assisting your entire personal life, Meta now wants to give businesses access to its leading AI models to help supercharge growth and productivity.
The company's new Meta Enterprise Platform will offer access to Muse agent, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code for businesses and developers.
“Meta already serves billions of people at scale and helps hundreds of millions of businesses reach customers. Today we are starting the next major pillar of our business, Meta Enterprise Platform, to help businesses use AI to grow and transform in new ways as well,” company CEO Mark Zuckerberg said in the announcement.
Meta offers AI power to businesses
The announcement also included Zuckerberg offering “strengths that few other companies have,” which includes, “advanced models, leading agents, large-scale infrastructure, and years of working closely with many businesses.”
Meta Muse and Meta Business Agent are recent additions to Meta’s lineup of AI agents. Business Agent was unveiled on June 3 2026, pitched as an AI agent “that lets every business show up for every customer as if they had an infinite team behind them.”
September 8 saw Muse unveiled as a personal AI agent, but in this case the tool is being rebranded as a small business assistant, offered alongside Meta's coding agent and the Muse API.
As part of the move to offer more AI access to businesses, Zuckerberg also announced former MongoDB CEO Chirantan Desai would be joining Meta as its new Chief Enterprise Platform Officer.

“Over the coming years, AI will fundamentally redefine how organizations of all sizes innovate, grow, serve customers, and run business operations,” Desai said in a statement. “Meta has a unique role to play because it is bringing together advanced models and leading agents with a proven track record of helping millions of advertisers and hundreds of millions of businesses scale.
“Meta Enterprise Platform will focus on turning its AI stack into products and services that companies can deploy for their own businesses. As with Muse, security and privacy are built into Meta’s enterprise products from the outset. Our goal is to make Meta the place enterprises come to scale their businesses. I’m incredibly grateful for the opportunity and looking forward to working with our customers along this journey,” Desai concluded.

articles.title: Montage Technology Announces Mass-Production of DDR5-9200 Clock Driver (CKD)
articles.text:
Tuesday, September 29th 2026
	
	
	
	
Montage Technology Announces Mass-Production of DDR5-9200 Clock Driver (CKD)
Montage Technology announced the mass-production of its DDR5 Clock Driver Plus (CK01P), designed to deliver stable and reliable clocking for next-generation client memory modules.
Compliant with the JEDEC DDR5CKD01 clock driver specification, the CK01P primarily targets next-generation client memory modules, including DDR5 CUDIMM, CSODIMM, CQDIMM, and CAMM and supports data rates of up to 9200 MT/s. The CK01P supports three clock operating modes—single PLL, dual PLL, and PLL bypass—to accommodate a wide range of system requirements. Featuring a zero-phase-delay clock architecture, the device supports programmable per-channel delay and allows output characteristics to be configured through control registers, enabling flexible adaptation to different DIMM network topologies. In addition, unused clock outputs can be disabled to further reduce power consumption.
Mr. Stephen Tai, President of Montage Technology."As AI applications continue to expand into client computing, client platforms are placing increasing demand on memory bandwidth, signal integrity, and power efficiency, driving DDR5 memory modules toward higher data rates and lower power consumption. The mass production of the CK01P comes at an important stage in this evolution, providing high-speed, stable clocking for next-generation DDR5 client memory modules and helping client platforms unlock enhanced performance in the AI era."
In addition to Clock Driver, Montage Technology offers SPD and PMIC chips for client memory modules, providing customers with a comprehensive client memory interface solution.

articles.title: Steam tiene Watch Dog 2 con descuento del 95% para PC por tiempo limitado
articles.text:
Watch_Dogs 2 tiene un descuento del 95% en Steam durante por tiempo limitado. El juego de Ubisoft puede incorporarse a la biblioteca de la plataforma con una rebaja sobre su precio habitual.
La promoción estará disponible hasta el 1 de octubre de 2026, según indica la tienda de Steam. La oferta también alcanza a las ediciones Deluxe y Gold del título.
PUBLICIDAD
El juego fue lanzado en 2016 y está disponible con interfaz, voces y subtítulos en español de Hispanoamérica.
Cómo acceder al juego en Steam
Para comprar Watch_Dogs 2, los usuarios deben ingresar a Steam desde la aplicación de escritorio o desde su sitio web, iniciar sesión con su cuenta y buscar el juego en la tienda.
Una vez en la página del producto, deben seleccionar la edición estándar, que es la que tiene el 95% de descuento, y pulsar el botón para añadirla al carrito. Después, podrán completar el pago con el método disponible en su región.
Tras la compra, el título quedará asociado a la biblioteca de Steam de forma permanente. Para ejecutarlo, será necesario instalarlo en una computadora compatible y vincular una cuenta de Ubisoft, antes conocida como Uplay, con la cuenta de Steam.
PUBLICIDAD
De qué trata Watch_Dogs 2
Watch_Dogs 2 es un juego de acción y aventura de mundo abierto desarrollado y publicado por Ubisoft. La historia transcurre en la zona de la bahía de San Francisco, una región marcada por el auge de las empresas tecnológicas.
El jugador controla a Marcus Holloway, un hacker que se une a DedSec, un grupo que busca exponer el uso de ctOS 2.0. En el juego, ese sistema operativo permite vigilar y manipular a los ciudadanos a gran escala.
La propuesta incluye exploración, sigilo, combate y hackeo de dispositivos conectados. También permite utilizar vehículos por radiocontrol, drones, armas impresas en 3D y herramientas para intervenir la infraestructura de la ciudad.

En el apartado gráfico, Steam indica como requisito mínimo una NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 o una AMD Radeon HD 7870, ambas con 2 GB de memoria de video. El juego requiere además 27 GB de espacio libre en el almacenamiento y una conexión de banda ancha a internet.
Para la configuración recomendada, Ubisoft sugiere un Intel Core i5-3470 a 3,2 GHz o un AMD FX-8120 a 3,9 GHz, 8 GB de RAM y una NVIDIA GeForce GTX 780 o AMD Radeon R9 290 con 3 GB de memoria de video. Estas especificaciones apuntan a jugar en 1080p, a más de 30 cuadros por segundo y con ajustes gráficos altos.

- Elle se configure rapidement depuis l'application Alexa
- Elle est déjà en promotion, sans attendre l'ouverture des Jours Flash Prime

Une enceinte pensée pour le quotidien
Sphérique et habillée de tissu, l'Echo Dot se glisse sur un bureau ou une étagère. On lui demande la météo, on lance un minuteur, un réveil ou une radio, et on pilote des lampes connectées via l'application Alexa.
Côté son, la génération actuelle offre des voix plus claires et jusqu'à deux fois plus de basses que la précédente. Ouest-France évoque un rendu équilibré, même à volume élevé, tandis que BlogNT juge que l'écart s'entend surtout en comparaison directe. articles.title: OpenAI launches Dots, always-on AI agents in ChatGPT with their own cloud computers - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
OpenAI launches Dots, always-on AI agents in ChatGPT with their own cloud computers
OpenAI Group PBC today used its DevDay developer conference to launch Dots, a set of always-on artificial intelligence agents in ChatGPT.
The release is aimed at moving ChatGPT users beyond working one prompt at a time. Someone can hand an agent a goal and let it carry the job forward without direction at every step, even while it has several other projects going. Each agent learns its owner’s preferences from feedback. OpenAI says some of the work will show up before anyone asks for it.
GPT-6 Astra powers the agents, and each one works from a cloud computer of its own that users can open at any time to see what it is doing. More than 4,000 apps are reachable through OpenAI’s plugins. With permission, an agent can also work directly on its owner’s laptop.
Users can message or call their agent in ChatGPT on desktop, web or mobile, or reach it in Slack and Teams. Because context follows the agent between channels, a project started in ChatGPT can be passed to a team in Slack without a fresh briefing. Agents send progress updates and questions back to their owners.
OpenAI has been using the agents on its own teams. When a bug gets reported in the company’s Slack, the agents start investigating right away, and new designs are turned into working apps while staff concentrate on customer feedback.
One early tester outside the company had forgotten to bill a publication. When his agent noticed, it prepared the invoice and waited for his approval before sending it.
When nobody has handed it a task, an agent goes looking for ways to help, which OpenAI calls proactive research. Its connections to the owner’s apps are read-only during that time, so it cannot send messages or change anything.
Actions that could touch a user’s accounts or share information must first clear a check called auto-review, and a monitoring system can pause or stop an agent over a safety concern. OpenAI tells users to review consequential work because the agents “can still make mistakes.”
OpenAI also previewed specialist agents that an employer provisions with their own identity and credentials for a single defined job. Procurement and invoice processing were among the jobs tested inside OpenAI. Customers start with focused pilots, in which OpenAI engineers help define what each agent is responsible for. Microsoft Corp. is working with OpenAI so specialist agents can be managed through the governance and security controls in Agent 365.
The new service also puts OpenAI up against Meta Platforms Inc., which released its Muse personal agent in the U.S. on Sept. 8. Like OpenAI’s agents, Muse runs on a dedicated computer in the cloud. Most of what people use it for is free, Meta said, with subscriptions sold to heavier users.
Dots began rolling out today to ChatGPT Pro and Business Premium subscribers, and some accounts may wait several days for access. Pro subscribers in the European Economic Area, Switzerland and the U.K. are not included. Enterprise customers, including those on Edu and Healthcare plans, can try a beta once a workspace administrator switches it on.
One agent comes with a Pro or Business Premium plan at no extra cost. OpenAI’s help documentation says agent usage will not count against plan allowances for the first month. Terms for each plan come after that. Additional agents, and more speed or monthly capacity for existing ones, are planned for later at prices OpenAI has not disclosed.

articles.title: Melhor notebook custo-benefício: 7 modelos para comprar em 2026 • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Melhor notebook custo-benefício: 7 modelos para comprar em 2026
Orçamento apertado? Conheça os notebooks que entregam mais pelo menor preço, de modelos básicos a opções gamer com bom custo-benefício
A busca pelo melhor notebook custo-benefício esbarra em um grande problema 2026: a alta nos preços dessa categoria resultante da crise global de memória RAM. Diante desse cenário, encontrar um computador com preço realmente acessível e boas configurações virou uma tarefa árdua.
Alinhando expectativas: é possível achar modelos básicos que lidam bem com as tarefas cotidianas por menos de R$ 4 mil. Também há laptops gamer com placa de vídeo dedicada e custos bem abaixo de versões high-end.
A seguir, o Tecnoblog lista sete opções de notebooks com bom custo-benefício de marcas como Asus, Acer, e Lenovo. Confira os prós e contras de cada modelo para saber qual é o melhor para o seu dia a dia.
O Asus Vivobook Go 15 é um notebook focado em desempenho equilibrado para tarefas do dia a dia, como edição de planilhas e outros documentos, navegação web e até jogos leves casuais. Ele combina o processador AMD Ryzen 5 7520U (4 núcleos e 8 threads) com 16 GB de RAM e SSD de 512 GB. Somente a memória interna é expansível.
A tela LED de 15,6″ tem resolução Full HD (1920 x 1080 pixels) e design com bordas finas, mas é limitada a 60 Hz. Há ainda uma webcam de 720p para videochamadas — componente que traz também uma tampa de privacidade.
O laptop é leve (1,63 kg) e fino (17,9 mm de espessura), e ainda traz resistência militar MIL-STD-810H. E a bateria de 42 Wh suporta carregamento rápido, levando 49 minutos para recarregar até 60%.
O Acer Nitro V15 é uma ótima opção de notebook gamer para orçamentos apertados. Ele traz o chip AMD Ryzen 7 7735HS (8 núcleos e 16 threads), além de 8 GB de RAM e SSD de 512 GB. E também conta com a placa de vídeo RTX 4050 (6 GB) para mais performance nas jogatinas.
A tela LCD de 15,6″ tem resolução Full HD e oferece boa fluidez com a taxa de atualização de 165 Hz. Já a webcam grava em 720p a 30 fps e consegue quebrar o galho em videoconferências e filmagens mais simples.
A bateria de 3.574 mAh tem autonomia de até 5 horas, mas vale usar o laptop na tomada durante as jogatinas para manter a performance. Pesando 2,1 kg, o laptop ainda tem um sistema de resfriamento com duas ventoinhas para evitar superaquecimentos.
O Acer Aspire 5 é a escolha ideal para quem busca um notebook de entrada eficiente para estudar, trabalhar com tarefas de escritório ou navegar na internet com fluidez. Equipado com o processador Ryzen 5 5500U, o modelo garante boa capacidade de multitarefa sem travamentos.
Completam o conjunto o SSD NVMe de 512 GB e 8 GB de memória RAM, com a possibilidade de expansões futuras em ambos os componentes.
Para o consumo de mídias, a tela LCD antirreflexo de 15,6″ entrega resolução Full HD para imagens nítidas, operando na taxa de atualização padrão de 60 Hz. Já nas videochamadas, a webcam HD de 720p é complementada por um sistema de inteligência artificial focado em reduzir ruídos do microfone.
Pesando 1,7 kg, o dispositivo se destaca pela portabilidade e pela autonomia de bateria de 48 Wh, capaz de alcançar até 12 horas de uso fora da tomada.
O Galaxy Book 4 ainda é a opção custo-benefício recomendada pela Samsung em 2026 para quem precisa de um notebook para tarefas simples, como streaming e navegação na web.
Ele chega com processador Intel Core i5-1335U (10 núcleos e 12 threads), 8 GB de RAM e SSD NVMe de 512 GB. Você pode adicionar mais memória interna com o slot adicional, mas a RAM é soldada na placa-mãe e não oferece upgrade.
A tela LCD tem tamanho de 15,6″, oferece resolução Full HD e inclui uma webcam de 1 MP. Também existe uma função nativa que permite usar o smartphone como webcam, se você preferir.
Bateria de 54 Wh, suporte ao Dolby Atmos e porta RJ45 completam as especificações do notebook de 1,55 kg.
O Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 (83MMS00100) é um notebook intermediário focado em quem busca um desempenho robusto para trabalho, estudo e multitarefa pesada, sem abrir mão de portabilidade e uma boa tela.
O grande diferencial da versão é o processador AMD Ryzen 7 7735HS, um chip de alto desempenho (série HS) com 8 núcleos e 16 threads, que trabalha em conjunto com 8 GB de RAM e oferece velocidade de sobra tanto para o uso do dia a dia quanto para softwares mais exigentes de edição e produtividade.
A Lenovo atualizou a experiência visual com uma tela levemente maior, com 15,3 polegadas WUXGA (1920 x 1200 pixels), na proporção 16:10, ideal para leitura e documentos. Para maior segurança, a webcam HD traz uma tampa física de privacidade.
O notebook oferece ainda porta USB-C com suporte a energia e vídeo, saídas USB-A, HDMI e leitor de cartões SD, além de teclado ABNT2 com numérico. O IdeaPad Slim 3 vem de fábrica com sistema operacional Linux, mas usuários que preferem Windows podem fazer a instalação posteriormente.
O Lenovo LOQ 15IRX9 é recomendado para quem busca um notebook gamer de entrada focado em rodar jogos menos exigentes e realizar tarefas pesadas com bom desempenho. Ele é ideal para quem quer jogar com fluidez sem necessariamente investir em um modelo high-end.
Alimentado pelo processador Intel Core i5-13450HX, com 10 núcleos e 16 threads, o dispositivo atua em conjunto com 16 GB de RAM e SSD de 512 GB. A placa de vídeo dedicada RTX 3050, com 6 GB de VRAM, assegura o processamento gráfico necessário para a categoria.
Sua tela LCD de 15,6 polegadas conta com resolução Full HD e taxa de atualização de 144 Hz, que reduz o desfoque em gameplays ágeis. O modelo inclui webcam 1080p, porta RJ45 para internet cabeada e o design térmico de hipercâmara, mantendo o sistema resfriado durante sessões prolongadas.
Com 2,3 kg de peso, o modelo reflete a estrutura típica de um laptop focado em performance. Sua bateria de 60 Wh oferece suporte a carregamento rápido, garantindo praticidade ao usuário que precisa recuperar a carga do aparelho com agilidade.
O MacBook Neo é o notebook da Apple com preço mais acessível no portfólio atual, considerando o custo de modelos Pro ou Air. Ele chega com o chip A18 Pro, 8 GB de memória unificada e SSD de 512 GB e torna-se uma ótima porta de entrada para o ecossistema da marca.
A tela Liquid Retina de 13 polegadas tem resolução nativa de 2408 x 1506 pixels e taxa de atualização de 60 Hz. A webcam integrada grava em 1080p, enquanto os dois alto-falantes laterais entregam sons compatíveis com áudio espacial e Dolby Atmos.
A bateria é um dos destaques, com autonomia para até 16 horas de vídeo. O laptop pesa apenas 1,2 kg e tem um design compacto, facilitando o transporte em rotinas agitadas.
Para escolher o melhor notebook custo-benefício em 2026, é preciso filtrar componentes que entregam a maior eficiência por real investido, evitando gargalos de desempenho e obsolescência precoce:
Atualmente, 8 GB de RAM representam o padrão mínimo para notebooks rodarem apps simultaneamente com menos chances de travar. Já laptops com 16 GB de RAM são indicados para quem não abre mão de fluidez, especialmente em ferramentas pesadas e multitarefa.
O Acer Nitro V15 (ANV15-41-R6J0) é o melhor notebook gamer custo-benefício da lista devido ao preço competitivo na faixa dos R$ 5 mil. Ele conta com o chip Ryzen 5 5500U, RTX 4050 (6 GB) e tela Full HD. E apesar de oferecer 8 GB de RAM e SSD de 512 GB, o aparelho suporta expansão de RAM e memória interna para ainda mais desempenho.
O Asus Vivobook Go 15 (E1504FA-NJ1288) é o melhor notebook para estudar dentre os modelos listados. Seu design leve e fino facilita a portabilidade para escola ou faculdade, enquanto os 16 GB de RAM melhoram o desempenho multitarefas. Ele também tem resistência militar e webcam de 720p para reuniões em aulas online.

articles.title: « C’est la folie en ce moment » chez Apple : John Ternus voudrait bouleverser la stratégie du groupe
articles.text:
Le 10 juillet dernier, nous avions jugé la performance de John Ternus lors de sa première keynote. Nous avions trouvé que la passation de pouvoir entre Tim Cook et Ternus était sobre et élégante, mais aussi que le nouveau patron d’Apple avait manqué quelque peu d’audace. Mais cette audace qui semblait manquer lors de l’événement ne pointerait-t-elle pas le bout de son nez, et pas qu’un peu ? Le toujours très bien informé Mark Gurman, journaliste chez Bloomberg, est venu rapporter des discussions de Ternus en interne avec ses collègues, et autant dire qu’un chamboulement semble s’annoncer chez Apple.
Une restructuration chez Apple
Alors que John Ternus occupe le poste de CEO d’Apple depuis maintenant presque un mois, une restructuration s’annonce au sein de l’entreprise. Selon Mark Gurman, Ternus voudrait supprimer certains postes de cadres intermédiaires afin de réduire les niveaux hiérarchiques. Sans grande surprise, Ternus aurait considéré l’intelligence artificielle pour les remplacer, soit une stratégie également étudiée par Mark Zuckerberg. L’objectif serait d’accélérer le développement des produits en supprimant certaines couches hiérarchiques. In fine, Apple présenterait une organisation plus légère, davantage axée sur l’ingénierie.
Plus globalement, Ternus aurait comme objectif de réduire les coûts, tout en trouvant de nouvelles rentrées d’argent. Pour ce faire, l’entreprise miserait sur ses produits existants en proposant de nouveaux services, et donc de nouveaux abonnements. Il faut préciser que le chiffre d’affaires des services d’Apple s’est contracté au deuxième trimestre, une première depuis 2022, même s’il reste supérieur à celui enregistré un an plus tôt. Par ailleurs, l’Apple Store connaît lui aussi un ralentissement de son chiffre d’affaires dans un contexte marqué par de nouvelles réglementations américaines et européennes. John Ternus voudrait ainsi restructurer l’entreprise et se concentrer sur les services, mais pas seulement.
Produire plus, plus fréquemment et dans des délais plus courts
Toujours selon Mark Gurman, John Ternus souhaiterait s’éloigner du calendrier habituel d’Apple, marqué par une keynote au printemps et une autre à l’automne. L’objectif serait de lancer de nouveaux produits à d’autres moments de l’année, et ainsi accélérer le rythme de sortie. Ce nouveau mode opératoire passe inévitablement par une accélération du développement des produits. John Ternus voudrait que les équipes d’Apple livrent plus de produits, plus fréquemment et dans des délais plus courts. Par ailleurs, Ternus souhaiterait que l’entreprise se montre plus expérimentale afin de rester compétitive à l’ère de l’intelligence artificielle.
Une pression conséquente serait d’ores et déjà ressentie par certains employés de l’entreprise. Selon Gurman, l’un d’entre eux, qui a désiré rester anonyme, a expliqué que « tout est beaucoup plus opérationnel qu’avant », avant de préciser ensuite : « C’est la folie en ce moment. » Nous espérions davantage d’audace de la part de John Ternus, mais peut-être pas à ce point.

articles.title: After 10 days with the Apple Watch Series 12, I'm disturbed by one 'slightly off' reading
articles.text:
I've been wearing the Apple Watch Series 12 for 10 days, but I can't stop thinking about one 'slightly off' reading
Wait, I'm what?!
Remember when the Apple Watch was just a fitness gadget, primarily devoted to notifications and workout tracking? Now it's like a medical technician on your wrist, measuring everything from heart rate (with readings every 5 seconds), temperature, blood oxygen, respiratory rate, and sleep. It's so comprehensive that it can now, with the enhanced Vital apps, give an overall sense of your current well-being.
Apple gave its now two-year-old Vitals section a makeover in preparation for the upcoming Readiness view in the soon-to-be-released redesigned Health App. In the meantime, you can see Readiness in Fitness. It uses readings from Apple Watch (Vitals, Sleep, Activity) to come up with a Readiness score. Basically, the number, on a scale from 1 to 10, tells you how ready you are to take on the challenges of the day. Today, I'm a 7!
I'm not a health nut, but I try to keep physically active and in shape, and I generally watch what I eat (and sometimes that means watching myself eat a donut). On my Apple Watch Series 12 — as with previous Apple Watches — I enjoy tracking my workouts and, ever since I started wearing the watch to sleep, my sleep score. Apparently I get, on average, roughly 4.75 hours or so of sleep a night (ugh).
For my needs, knowing that I completed a workout and that my sleep is good (or not) is enough, but perhaps I'm not typical. Certainly, Apple has seen an opportunity to transform the Apple Watch into a true and more proactive health wearable, one that can not only measure vitals in real time but also alert you to potentially serious issues.
Apple Watch knows a lot about you
We've all read stories of the Apple Watch detecting potential heart issues and people then getting checked out by a professional and discovering a real, albeit treatable issue. Apple Watch has long been able to help you in dire situations like a car crash or fall. When I took a spill not too long ago, I set off Apple Watch's fall detection (I wasn't hurt, so I stopped it from dialing emergency services), and I saw it do the same when a relative took a particularly dramatic tumble, where I think we let the call go through (she's fine). I do often recommend the Apple Watch as an eldercare device.
These are all positives, but I'd be lying if I didn't admit that the level of physical data my Apple Watch is now collecting and collating in the Health app (and Fitness App) is overwhelming.
With Apple leaning harder and harder into health tracking, Apple made a major sensor change for the Apple Watch Series 12. Its new sunburst-style heart rate sensor features large green LEDs (replacing the sparser red diodes) in a ring array capable of taking heart rate readings every five seconds (there's also 24% more watch surface-to-skin contact). Now I have Heart Rate Variability (HRV) readings that are fed to, among other things, the enhanced Vitals section in Health.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
It's here that I happened to notice a single "Slightly Off" Vital reading and started spiralling, wondering, worrying, and also laughing because it would not be the first time I've been called "Slightly Off". Normal readings are called "Typical", and, I guess, if you're lucky or super healthy, "Favorable."
What's wrong with me?
Vitals combine respiratory rate, wrist temperature, Blood Oxygen, Recovery HRV, and sleep duration (each day shows the average for each measurement). The single "Slightly Off" reading was attributed to a high heart rate while sleeping. Apple Watch Series 12's ability to measure heart rate every five seconds (previous Apple Watches could only do it every five minutes) meant that this was probably a pretty accurate reading.
According to Vitals, my typical sleeping heart rate is 51bpm. On September 25th, the heart rate shown was 60BPM. That's not super high, but based on my average, it is, in fact, "Slightly off".
So what am I to do with this information? For now, nothing. After all, this is a single day and, since then, I've had nothing but "Typical" Vitals measurements.
We're still weeks or more away from a Health App redesign that might make all this data even more digestible, to say nothing of all the AI features (Live Rewind and Siri Recap) that are due in late 2026.
Even though Apple Watch Series 12 doesn't look much different from its predecessor, I've come to realize that the almost constant heart monitoring, and the sheer mountain of data the wearable is now collecting, is potentially a health game changer. I still find it all overwhelming, but I can guarantee I'll be watching like a hawk for the next "Slightly Off" reading.

Marshall Announces the Bromley 150 Portable Speaker with User Replaceable Battery
Featuring True Stereophonic 360° technology, inspired by the origins of stereo recording, Bromley 150 uses Marshall's patented acoustic design to preserve depth and detail. By spreading rich mids, detailed highs, and deep bass evenly, every corner of the party becomes a sweet spot.
Drawing from the same bold and unique design as its predecessors, Bromley 150 has been subtly adapted to suit its more compact form, while still fitting seamlessly within the broader Bromley family.
